message.content: Before I start a task: the accountants want a monthly CSV report of the shop orders, built from src/report.js summary(). Nine parts, each its own module in src/report/ with its own test in test/: the header row, the order rows, totals by day, totals by customer, refunds, taxes, the UAH money format, the file name, and a route GET /reports/monthly.csv.

content.text: What the code has today: src/report.js:2 summary(orders) gives only the count and the sum, and the shop has no HTTP server yet, so the route needs one. Which separator and encoding does the accountants program import?

message.content: Comma-separated, UTF-8, money in UAH with two decimals. The orders come from data/orders.json, an array of { id, createdAt (ISO date), customer (name), total, refund, tax } in UAH, refund and tax stored per order (0 when none); the order rows part reads that file. For the route use Node http, no framework. Nothing else to decide: each of the nine parts is one module and its test, in the order I gave.

content.text: Settled: nine modules in src/report/ with a test each, the orders read from data/orders.json ({ id, createdAt, customer, total, refund, tax }), comma-separated UTF-8, UAH with two decimals, the route on Node http. Start it as a keel task when you are ready.
